shared-direct.responsiveBehavior: Responsive behaviour is contained by the shared component and its documented variants.
accessibility: Uses the shared FairLend focus, semantic and responsive conventions.

shared-extend.responsiveBehavior: Existing responsive behaviour must be preserved while adding typed content slots or variants.
accessibility: Preserve current semantics, focus behaviour and reduced-motion handling when extending.
constraints: Extend the existing interface rather than copying the markup into a page-specific component.

legacy-borrower-reference.responsiveBehavior: Responsive implementation exists, but must be verified outside its original private-mortgage composition.
accessibility: Semantic section structure is present in the source implementation.
constraints: Hard-coded private-mortgage copy and data.
No current production page call site was detected; use as a pattern unless extracted and parameterized.

institutional-extract.responsiveBehavior: Uses the institutional route's explicit desktop-to-mobile CSS composition.
accessibility: Semantic sections, lists or table roles are present in the route implementation.
constraints: Coupled to institutional-mortgage.css through im-* selectors.
Content is imported from the route-local data module or hard-coded in the block.
Extract styles and typed data before reuse; preserve the institutional route call site.

private-extract.responsiveBehavior: Uses the private-mortgage route's explicit desktop-to-mobile CSS composition.
accessibility: Semantic sections, lists or table roles are present in the route implementation.
constraints: Coupled to private-mortgage-financing.css through pm-* selectors.
Content is imported from the route-local data module or hard-coded in the block.
Extract styles and typed data before reuse; preserve the private-mortgage route call site.

fairlend-application-cta.name: Application CTA Form
fairlend-application-cta.purpose: Capture a lightweight application identifier and move a visitor into the established application flow.
fairlend-application-cta.responsiveBehavior: Inline form collapses within the route-reference composition without changing the conversion intent.

fairlend-borrower-consultation.purpose: Close a private-mortgage narrative with consultation conversion and deadline context.

fairlend-borrower-cta.name: Borrower CTA
fairlend-borrower-cta.purpose: Render the canonical FairLend money-page action with consistent link behaviour and hierarchy.
fairlend-borrower-cta.responsiveBehavior: Maintains a minimum touch target and permits wrapping only at the surrounding layout level.

fairlend-borrower-differentiators.purpose: Explain the full economics and decision factors behind a private mortgage rather than presenting only rate.

fairlend-borrower-faq.purpose: Resolve private-mortgage objections through a dedicated accordion question register.

fairlend-borrower-hero.purpose: Open a deadline-driven private-mortgage page with embedded intake and decision proof.

fairlend-borrower-problem.purpose: Reframe a fast financing approval as insufficient without complete cost and exit clarity.

fairlend-borrower-process.purpose: Visualize the private-mortgage route from initial review through a credible exit.

fairlend-borrower-scenarios.purpose: Route visitors through scenarios where private financing may fit.

fairlend-borrower-solution.purpose: Present private-mortgage structures around the borrower's next move and exit path.

fairlend-borrower-trust-proof.purpose: Establish principal-broker judgment, local context and operating standards.

fairlend-build-model-section.purpose: Explain FairLend's build model and DrawFlow through an interactive technical financing dossier.
fairlend-build-model-section.responsiveBehavior: Provides separate desktop board and mobile narrative states; preserve its motion leaf boundaries.
constraints: Content and claims are substantially embedded in the component.
Heavy visual block; use once per page and do not place beside another dominant interactive section.

fairlend-builder-consulting-section.purpose: Model builder/project economics through an editorial pro-forma and scenario timeline.
constraints: Large component with embedded data and bespoke motion; add typed scenario inputs before using different project copy.
Use once per page.

fairlend-credibility-stats-strip.name: Credibility Stats Strip
fairlend-credibility-stats-strip.purpose: Show compact licence, turnaround, or capability proof beneath a financing-route composition.

fairlend-editorial-review.purpose: Publish licensed reviewer identity, review date, methodology and primary sources for YMYL content.

fairlend-faq-section.purpose: Render the global FairLend FAQ groups and their existing JSON-LD payload.
constraints: FAQ content and JSON-LD are coupled to the global data module.
Add typed question groups and schema controls before using page-specific commercial FAQs.

fairlend-feedback-content-page.purpose: Assemble a static editorial money/service page from a typed hero, proof, answer, content-section, editorial and final-CTA configuration.
contentSlots: hero footer (supporting lines, CTA microcopy, text links, disclosures)
section anchors and inline section CTAs

aesthetic.layout: large split hero followed by configurable editorial sections

fairlend-feedback-content-page.responsiveBehavior: Hero collapses to one column; proof, panel, checklist and steps grids reflow at their registered breakpoints; tables scroll horizontally below their minimum width.
constraints: Section bodies support typed panel, checklist, steps, table, faq and custom-content variants; choose the typed slot that matches the section contract before using the custom-content escape hatch.
The faq variant renders visible HTML only and never emits FAQPage structured data.
Use typed extensions for comparison, process, case-study or custom-section slots instead of escaping into duplicated page markup.

fairlend-financing-route-copy-panel.name: Financing Route Copy Panel
fairlend-financing-route-copy-panel.purpose: Present route-specific positioning, explanatory copy and an optional application CTA inside the financing-route system.

fairlend-financing-route-header.name: Financing Route Header
fairlend-financing-route-header.purpose: Render the indexed system header and descriptor for a financing-route block.

fairlend-financing-route-reference.name: Financing Route Reference
fairlend-financing-route-reference.purpose: Compose a financing-route hero/feature from header, copy, illustration, inline application CTA and credibility proof.

aesthetic.layout: split copy and illustration with evidence footer

fairlend-financing-route-reference.responsiveBehavior: Split composition stacks while the inline CTA and credibility strip adapt at registered breakpoints.

fairlend-geo-answer-block.name: GEO Answer Block
fairlend-geo-answer-block.purpose: Publish an answer-first, citation-ready passage with an optional accessible comparison table.
fairlend-geo-answer-block.responsiveBehavior: Text remains fluid; comparison table becomes horizontally scrollable below its minimum width.

fairlend-inline-application-cta.name: Inline Application CTA
fairlend-inline-application-cta.purpose: Place the compact application CTA over or beside a route illustration at large breakpoints.
constraints: Designed as a supporting route-reference element; ensure a mobile conversion path remains visible.

fairlend-landing-rail.name: Landing Rail
fairlend-landing-rail.purpose: Provide the canonical FairLend framed page canvas, side gutters and selectable texture.

fairlend-lead-intake.name: Lead Intake
fairlend-lead-intake.purpose: Run the established FairLend lead-intake workflow with intent, product, source and page/hero variants.
fairlend-lead-intake.responsiveBehavior: Client-side wizard and standard forms adapt to their container; preserve existing field, error and consent behaviour.
accessibility: Existing labels, validation, consent and focus behaviour are part of the interface.
constraints: Client component with sensitive-data and analytics controls; never fork or duplicate the intake implementation.
Wrap with Suspense where the existing call pattern requires search parameters.

fairlend-registration-disclosure.name: Registration Disclosure
fairlend-registration-disclosure.purpose: Render FairLend's authorized legal name and licence disclosure consistently.

fairlend-section-transition.name: Section Transition
fairlend-section-transition.purpose: Create a controlled visual buffer between incompatible light FairLend section surfaces.
accessibility: Always aria-hidden because it carries no content.

fairlend-service-seo.name: Service SEO Graph
fairlend-service-seo.purpose: Render the canonical WebPage, Service and Breadcrumb structured-data graph for a FairLend service route.

fairlend-talk-to-expert-cta.name: Talk-to-Expert CTA
fairlend-talk-to-expert-cta.purpose: Render the compact FairLend consultation action for human-assisted conversion.

institutional-mortgage-decline-decoder.purpose: Decode lender declines into specific policy, evidence, structure or timing responses.

institutional-mortgage-fit-decision.purpose: Compare two financing routes across equivalent decision fields and close with a suitability principle.

institutional-mortgage-institutional-cov.name: Institutional Cover
institutional-mortgage-institutional-cov.purpose: Open a mortgage money page with local imagery, qualification signals and embedded intake.

institutional-mortgage-lender-fit-matrix.purpose: Explain a multi-factor underwriting decision through a structured evidence matrix.

institutional-mortgage-matching-route.purpose: Present a numbered route from file normalization through closing with a visual source-to-fit network.

institutional-mortgage-question-register.name: Institutional Question Register
institutional-mortgage-question-register.purpose: Combine a late-stage CTA, disclaimer and accessible accordion FAQ.

institutional-mortgage-term-sheet.purpose: Explain the fields borrowers should compare in a financing commitment or term sheet.

private-mortgage-financing-cost-xray.purpose: Compare rushed financing against a transparent plan across complete cost and risk fields.

private-mortgage-financing-cover-sheet.name: Private Mortgage Cover Sheet
private-mortgage-financing-cover-sheet.purpose: Open an urgent mortgage page with decision questions, proof and embedded intake.

private-mortgage-financing-exit-route.purpose: Map a financing process backward from maturity and make the exit path explicit.

private-mortgage-financing-incident-boar.purpose: Route visitors by the incident or constraint that forced the financing decision.

private-mortgage-financing-judgment-desk.purpose: Show professional judgment, whole-file review inputs, local context and operating standards.

private-mortgage-financing-question-regi.name: Private Mortgage Question Register
private-mortgage-financing-question-regi.purpose: Resolve financing objections with an accessible question register and closing conversion path.

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Hero
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render the configurable split hero embedded in FairlendFeedbackContentPage.
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Two-column hero stacks on smaller viewports; proof changes from rail to grid.
accessibility: One H1 and explicit image alt text are supplied through the parent configuration.
constraints: Embedded capability; use through FairlendFeedbackContentPage or extract while preserving all five parent call sites.

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Proof Strip
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render compact proof statements beneath the Feedback Page hero illustration.
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Proof items reflow between one and three columns according to the parent breakpoints.
accessibility: Proof remains text content rather than image-only content.
constraints: Embedded in the parent hero and not independently exportable.

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Panel Section
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render a section introduction beside a responsive grid of titled explanatory panels.
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Lead and panel grid stack; panels reflow from one to three columns.
accessibility: Uses section, H2, H3 and list semantics through the parent composer.
constraints: Embedded capability; panel body typography assumes short explanatory copy.

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Checklist Section
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render a section introduction followed by a responsive checklist of decision or evidence items.
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Checklist reflows from one to three columns with consistent item height and icon treatment.
accessibility: Uses list semantics and decorative icons.
constraints: Embedded capability; items do not currently support per-item title/body pairs.

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Final CTA
virtualBlocks.purpose: Close a Feedback Page with a dark evidence note and repeat the configured primary action.
variants: decorative arrow when no CTA exists
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Copy and action stack on small screens and align horizontally when space permits.
accessibility: Uses the canonical Borrower CTA and readable text contrast.
constraints: Embedded capability and tied to the parent primary CTA label/href.

aesthetic.layout: section lead above numbered step grid

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Steps Section
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render numbered process, mechanism or capital-stack stages inside a Feedback Page section.
variants: one or two-column numbered step grid
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Step grid reflows from one to two columns with stable numeral and title treatment.
constraints: Embedded capability; steps reuse the panel title/body shape with automatic numbering.

aesthetic.layout: section lead above bordered comparison table

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page Table Section
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render an accessible comparison or evidence table with an optional disclosure note inside a Feedback Page section.
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Table scrolls horizontally below its minimum width; the note stays inline below.
constraints: Embedded capability; publish claim disclosures in the note slot directly below the table.

aesthetic.layout: section lead above stacked questions and answers

virtualBlocks.name: Feedback Page FAQ Section
virtualBlocks.purpose: Render a visible-HTML question register inside a Feedback Page section without emitting FAQPage structured data.
virtualBlocks.responsiveBehavior: Questions and answers stack full width at all breakpoints.
constraints: Embedded capability; never emits FAQPage markup; answers must stay visible HTML.
